heuristics.statement: Retired hardware instructions on the Apple M4 build convert to collision-frontier-v5 word-RAM operations at 25 ops/instruction, the transfer price of the promoted sibling package 50592e75. Applied to the three charged processes: scan 160,429,645,672, z3 solve 1,897,370,783,016, K-scan 567,935,304,369 retired instructions.
heuristics.scope: The three instrumented processes of the Section 3 chain on this machine (macOS arm64, /usr/bin/time -l). It does not price unmeasured lab work (separate flat allowance, H-TOOL).
heuristics.extrapolation: Retired instructions proxy the executed word-RAM op count. The K-scan measures 196.95 retired instructions/draw at 2^31.425 drawn trials, consistent with the 157.2-190.4 instr/draw of five earlier runs of the same source. Sensitivity: at 13 ops/instr the total is 2^34.8673; at 50 it is 2^35.2946; both below the pending queue head 36.64.
heuristics.limitations: Retired instructions undercount non-executed issue slots and memory stalls relative to a strict word-RAM emulation; the x1.10 margin plus the explicit 13/50 ops-per-instruction sweep bound the exposure. The 25/instr constant is transferred from the promoted sibling, not re-derived here.
